typedef struct mz_stream_s
    {
        const unsigned char *next_in; /* pointer to next byte to read */
        unsigned int avail_in;        /* number of bytes available at next_in */
        mz_ulong total_in;            /* total number of bytes consumed so far */

        unsigned char *next_out; /* pointer to next byte to write */
        unsigned int avail_out;  /* number of bytes that can be written to next_out */
        mz_ulong total_out;      /* total number of bytes produced so far */

        char *msg;                       /* error msg (unused) */
        struct mz_internal_state *state; /* internal state, allocated by zalloc/zfree */

        mz_alloc_func zalloc; /* optional heap allocation function (defaults to malloc) */
        mz_free_func zfree;   /* optional heap free function (defaults to free) */
        void *opaque;         /* heap alloc function user pointer */

        int data_type;     /* data_type (unused) */
        mz_ulong adler;    /* adler32 of the source or uncompressed data */
        mz_ulong reserved; /* not used */
    } mz_stream;

    typedef mz_stream *mz_streamp;
objects.description: Primary compression/decompression stream descriptor compatible with a subset of zlib’s z_stream. Holds input/output buffers, counters, optional custom allocator hooks, and an opaque internal state pointer used by deflate/inflate. Initialize by zeroing or setting hooks, then pass to mz_deflateInit/mz_inflateInit, and finalize with mz_deflateEnd/mz_inflateEnd. The internal state is managed by the API; do not manipulate directly.

functions.name: mz_free
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT void mz_free(void *p);
functions.description: Frees a heap block previously allocated by miniz APIs. Internally calls MZ_FREE (by default free()). Use to release memory returned by miniz helper functions that allocate on the heap.
requirements: p should be a pointer previously allocated by miniz (or the allocator configured via MZ_MALLOC/MZ_FREE)
Pointer must be valid; behavior for NULL is unknown (not documented)
Call only once per allocated block to avoid double free

functions.name: mz_adler32
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_ulong mz_adler32(mz_ulong adler, const unsigned char *ptr, size_t buf_len);
functions.description: Computes or updates an Adler-32 checksum over a buffer. Pass ptr==NULL to obtain the initial Adler-32 value to start a stream.
requirements: If ptr is NULL, buf_len is ignored and the function returns the initial Adler-32 value
If ptr is non-NULL, it must point to at least buf_len readable bytes
adler should be MZ_ADLER32_INIT when starting a new stream, or the running checksum value when continuing

functions.name: mz_crc32
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_ulong mz_crc32(mz_ulong crc, const unsigned char *ptr, size_t buf_len);
functions.description: Computes or updates a CRC-32 checksum over a buffer. Pass ptr==NULL to obtain the initial CRC-32 value to start a stream.
requirements: If ptr is NULL, buf_len is ignored and the function returns the initial CRC-32 value
If ptr is non-NULL, it must point to at least buf_len readable bytes
crc should be MZ_CRC32_INIT when starting a new stream, or the running checksum value when continuing

functions.name: mz_version
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT const char *mz_version(void);
functions.description: Returns the miniz version string at compile time. Useful for logging or compatibility checks.

functions.name: mz_deflateInit
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT int mz_deflateInit(mz_streamp pStream, int level);
functions.description: Initializes a compressor with default options and the specified compression level.
requirements: pStream must point to an initialized mz_stream struct
level must be in the range [MZ_NO_COMPRESSION, MZ_BEST_COMPRESSION]
On success returns MZ_OK; may return MZ_STREAM_ERROR (bad stream), MZ_PARAM_ERROR (bad params), or MZ_MEM_ERROR (out of memory)
Before calling mz_deflate after init, set next_in/avail_in and next_out/avail_out appropriately

functions.name: mz_deflateInit2
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT int mz_deflateInit2(mz_streamp pStream, int level, int method, int window_bits, int mem_level, int strategy);
functions.description: Initializes a compressor with extended control over method, window, memory level, and strategy.
requirements: pStream must point to an initialized mz_stream struct
level must be in the range [MZ_NO_COMPRESSION, MZ_BEST_COMPRESSION]
method must be MZ_DEFLATED
window_bits must be MZ_DEFAULT_WINDOW_BITS (zlib header/adler) or -MZ_DEFAULT_WINDOW_BITS (raw deflate)
mem_level must be in [1, 9] (checked but ignored)
strategy should be one of MZ_DEFAULT_STRATEGY, MZ_FILTERED, MZ_HUFFMAN_ONLY, MZ_RLE, or MZ_FIXED
Returns MZ_OK on success; may return MZ_STREAM_ERROR, MZ_PARAM_ERROR, or MZ_MEM_ERROR

functions.name: mz_deflateReset
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT int mz_deflateReset(mz_streamp pStream);
functions.description: Quickly resets an existing compressor without reallocating, equivalent to mz_deflateEnd() followed by mz_deflateInit()/mz_deflateInit2().
requirements: pStream must be a compressor previously initialized by mz_deflateInit/mz_deflateInit2
Returns MZ_OK on success; may return MZ_STREAM_ERROR if the stream is invalid

functions.name: mz_deflate
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT int mz_deflate(mz_streamp pStream, int flush);
functions.description: Compresses input into output, consuming as much input and producing as much output as possible per call. Supports zlib-like flush modes.
requirements: pStream must be a valid, initialized compressor; update next_in, avail_in, next_out, avail_out before each call
flush must be one of MZ_NO_FLUSH, MZ_PARTIAL_FLUSH/MZ_SYNC_FLUSH, MZ_FULL_FLUSH, or MZ_FINISH

Handle return codes: MZ_OK (progress/more work), MZ_STREAM_END (all input consumed and output written; do not call again), MZ_STREAM_ERROR, MZ_PARAM_ERROR, MZ_BUF_ERROR (no progress; provide more input or output space)

functions.name: mz_deflateEnd
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT int mz_deflateEnd(mz_streamp pStream);
functions.description: Deinitializes a compressor and releases associated resources.
requirements: pStream must be a compressor previously initialized by mz_deflateInit/mz_deflateInit2
Returns MZ_OK on success or MZ_STREAM_ERROR if the stream is invalid
Do not call mz_deflate on this stream after a successful end

functions.name: mz_deflateBound
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_ulong mz_deflateBound(mz_streamp pStream, mz_ulong source_len);
functions.description: Returns a very conservative upper bound on the compressed size for a given source length, assuming only MZ_NO_FLUSH or MZ_FINISH are used.
requirements: pStream must be a valid compressor (initialized)
source_len is the number of input bytes to be potentially compressed

functions.name: mz_compress
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT int mz_compress(unsigned char *pDest, mz_ulong *pDest_len, const unsigned char *pSource, mz_ulong source_len);
functions.description: Single-call compression helper that compresses an entire buffer using default compression level.
requirements: pDest must point to a buffer at least *pDest_len bytes; on return *pDest_len is set to the actual compressed size
pDest_len must be a valid pointer to the size variable
pSource must point to source_len readable bytes
Returns MZ_OK on success or an error code from mz_deflate() on failure

functions.name: mz_compress2
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT int mz_compress2(unsigned char *pDest, mz_ulong *pDest_len, const unsigned char *pSource, mz_ulong source_len, int level);
functions.description: Single-call compression helper with explicit compression level.
requirements: pDest must point to a buffer at least *pDest_len bytes; on return *pDest_len is set to the actual compressed size
pDest_len must be a valid pointer to the size variable
pSource must point to source_len readable bytes
level must be in [MZ_NO_COMPRESSION, MZ_BEST_COMPRESSION] (or MZ_DEFAULT_COMPRESSION)
Returns MZ_OK on success or an error code from mz_deflate() on failure

functions.name: mz_compressBound
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_ulong mz_compressBound(mz_ulong source_len);
functions.description: Returns a very conservative upper bound on the compressed size for a single-call compression of source_len bytes.
requirements: source_len is the number of input bytes to be potentially compressed

functions.name: mz_inflateInit
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT int mz_inflateInit(mz_streamp pStream);
functions.description: Initializes a decompressor for zlib-wrapped streams with default window size.
requirements: pStream must point to an initialized mz_stream struct
Returns MZ_OK on success; may return standard error codes

functions.name: mz_inflateInit2
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT int mz_inflateInit2(mz_streamp pStream, int window_bits);
functions.description: Initializes a decompressor with control over window size and header/footer handling.
requirements: pStream must point to an initialized mz_stream struct
window_bits must be MZ_DEFAULT_WINDOW_BITS (parse zlib header/footer) or -MZ_DEFAULT_WINDOW_BITS (raw deflate)
Returns MZ_OK on success; may return standard error codes

functions.name: mz_inflateReset
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT int mz_inflateReset(mz_streamp pStream);
functions.description: Quickly resets a decompressor without reallocating, equivalent to mz_inflateEnd() followed by mz_inflateInit()/mz_inflateInit2().
requirements: pStream must be a decompressor previously initialized by mz_inflateInit/mz_inflateInit2
Returns MZ_OK on success; may return MZ_STREAM_ERROR if the stream is invalid

functions.name: mz_inflate
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT int mz_inflate(mz_streamp pStream, int flush);
functions.description: Decompresses input to output, consuming as little input and producing as much output as possible per call. Supports zlib-like flush semantics and single-call fast path when using MZ_FINISH initially.
requirements: pStream must be a valid, initialized decompressor; update next_in, avail_in, next_out, avail_out before each call
flush must be MZ_NO_FLUSH, MZ_SYNC_FLUSH, or MZ_FINISH
On first call, if flush is MZ_FINISH, both input and output buffers must be large enough for the entire stream
MZ_FINISH implies no more source bytes are available beyond current input buffer and output buffer is large enough to hold the rest of the decompressed data

Handle return codes: MZ_OK (progress/more work), MZ_STREAM_END (done and, for zlib streams, adler-32 verified), MZ_STREAM_ERROR, MZ_DATA_ERROR (invalid deflate stream), MZ_PARAM_ERROR, MZ_BUF_ERROR (needs more input or output space)

functions.name: mz_inflateEnd
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT int mz_inflateEnd(mz_streamp pStream);
functions.description: Deinitializes a decompressor and releases associated resources.
requirements: pStream must be a decompressor previously initialized by mz_inflateInit/mz_inflateInit2
Returns MZ_OK on success or MZ_STREAM_ERROR if the stream is invalid

functions.name: mz_uncompress
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT int mz_uncompress(unsigned char *pDest, mz_ulong *pDest_len, const unsigned char *pSource, mz_ulong source_len);
functions.description: Single-call decompression helper that expands a full compressed buffer to the provided destination buffer.
requirements: pDest must point to a buffer at least *pDest_len bytes; on return *pDest_len is set to the actual decompressed size
pDest_len must be a valid pointer to the size variable
pSource must point to source_len readable bytes of compressed data
Returns MZ_OK on success or an error code from mz_inflate() on failure

functions.name: mz_uncompress2
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT int mz_uncompress2(unsigned char *pDest, mz_ulong *pDest_len, const unsigned char *pSource, mz_ulong *pSource_len);
functions.description: Single-call decompression helper with input-length in/out parameter. Decompresses up to *pSource_len bytes and updates it with the number of bytes consumed.
requirements: pDest must point to a buffer at least *pDest_len bytes; on return *pDest_len is set to the actual decompressed size
pDest_len must be a valid pointer to the size variable
pSource must point to at least *pSource_len readable bytes; on return *pSource_len is updated to the number of bytes consumed
Returns MZ_OK on success or an error code from mz_inflate() on failure

functions.name: mz_error
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT const char *mz_error(int err);
functions.description: Returns a constant string describing the specified error code, or NULL if the code is invalid.

functions.signature: static int uncompress2(unsigned char* pDest, mz_ulong* pDest_len, const unsigned char* pSource, mz_ulong* pSource_len);
functions.description: zlib-compatibility wrapper that forwards to mz_uncompress2().
requirements: Same as mz_uncompress2: pDest buffer sized via *pDest_len; valid pointers; *pSource_len is in/out

functions.name: crc32
functions.signature: static mz_ulong crc32(mz_ulong crc, const unsigned char *ptr, size_t buf_len);
functions.description: zlib-compatibility wrapper that forwards to mz_crc32(). Computes or updates CRC-32; ptr==NULL returns initial value.
requirements: Same as mz_crc32: ptr may be NULL to get initial value; otherwise must point to at least buf_len bytes; crc should be MZ_CRC32_INIT when starting a new stream

functions.name: adler32
functions.signature: static mz_ulong adler32(mz_ulong adler, const unsigned char *ptr, size_t buf_len);
functions.description: zlib-compatibility wrapper that forwards to mz_adler32(). Computes or updates Adler-32; ptr==NULL returns initial value.
requirements: Same as mz_adler32: ptr may be NULL to get initial value; otherwise must point to at least buf_len bytes; adler should be MZ_ADLER32_INIT when starting a new stream

functions.name: zError
functions.signature: static const char* zError(int err);
functions.description: zlib-compatibility wrapper that forwards to mz_error(). Returns a string for a given error code.
requirements: err should be a valid MZ_* error code

functions.name: zlibVersion
functions.signature: const char *zlibVersion(void);
functions.description: Preprocessor alias to mz_version(). Returns the miniz version string. Provided for zlib API compatibility.

functions.name: miniz_def_alloc_func
functions.signature: void *miniz_def_alloc_func(void *opaque, size_t items, size_t size);
functions.description: Default allocation callback used by miniz (inferred). Allocates a memory block of items * size bytes, optionally using the opaque context. Intended to be passed as an allocator function to miniz APIs or called to obtain zero/uninitialized memory depending on implementation (exact initialization semantics unknown). Returns a pointer to the allocated block or NULL on failure.
requirements: opaque: Opaque user/context pointer passed through by the caller; may be NULL (inferred from common callback patterns).
items and size specify the allocation request as a count and element size; callers should ensure items * size does not overflow size_t (inferred).
On success, the returned pointer must be freed with miniz_def_free_func or resized with miniz_def_realloc_func; do not mix with other allocators (inferred).
On allocation failure, the function returns NULL; callers must check for NULL before use (inferred).

functions.name: miniz_def_free_func
functions.signature: void miniz_def_free_func(void *opaque, void *address);
functions.description: Default free callback used by miniz (inferred). Frees a memory block previously allocated by miniz_def_alloc_func or miniz_def_realloc_func, optionally using the opaque context.
requirements: opaque: Opaque user/context pointer passed through by the caller; may be NULL (inferred).

address must be a pointer previously returned by miniz_def_alloc_func or miniz_def_realloc_func, or NULL if the implementation supports free(NULL) as a no-op (NULL handling not documented; treat as implementation-defined).
Do not pass pointers allocated by other allocators to this function (inferred).
After a successful call, the address must not be used again (use-after-free is invalid).

functions.name: miniz_def_realloc_func
functions.signature: void *miniz_def_realloc_func(void *opaque, void *address, size_t items, size_t size);
functions.description: Default reallocation callback used by miniz (inferred). Changes the size of a memory block to items * size bytes, optionally using the opaque context. If address is NULL, acts like allocation. Returns a pointer to the resized block (which may be moved) or NULL on failure (original block may remain valid depending on implementation; exact semantics not documented).
requirements: opaque: Opaque user/context pointer passed through by the caller; may be NULL (inferred).
address must be NULL or a pointer previously returned by miniz_def_alloc_func/miniz_def_realloc_func (inferred).
items and size specify the new size; callers should ensure items * size does not overflow size_t (inferred).
On success, the returned pointer must subsequently be freed with miniz_def_free_func; the old pointer must not be used if a different pointer is returned (inferred).

On failure, the function returns NULL; callers must check for NULL before use. If NULL is returned and address was non-NULL, the original block may remain allocated; callers should assume it is unchanged unless documented otherwise (conservative, inferred).

functions.name: tdefl_compress_mem_to_heap
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT void *tdefl_compress_mem_to_heap(const void *pSrc_buf, size_t src_buf_len, size_t *pOut_len, int flags);
functions.description: Compresses a memory buffer and returns a newly malloc()'d heap block containing the deflate (optionally zlib-wrapped) data. Intended for one-shot compression where the entire input is available. The caller owns and must free() the returned buffer. Flags control header/adler32 behavior, parsing strategy, and the max dictionary probe count.
requirements: pSrc_buf must point to at least src_buf_len readable bytes (or may be non-dereferenced if src_buf_len == 0).
pOut_len must be a valid, non-NULL pointer; on success it is set to the compressed size (which may exceed src_buf_len for incompressible data).
flags may OR together TDEFL_* flags; the low 12 bits specify the max number of probes per dictionary search (0..4095, mask TDEFL_MAX_PROBES_MASK).
On success, the returned pointer must be freed with free() when no longer needed.
Function returns NULL on failure; callers must check for NULL before using *pOut_len.

functions.name: tdefl_compress_mem_to_mem
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT size_t tdefl_compress_mem_to_mem(void *pOut_buf, size_t out_buf_len, const void *pSrc_buf, size_t src_buf_len, int flags);
functions.description: Compresses a memory buffer into a caller-provided output buffer. Useful for bounded-output contexts. Returns the number of bytes written on success, or 0 on failure (e.g., output buffer too small). Flags control header/adler32 behavior, parsing strategy, and probe count.
requirements: pOut_buf must point to at least out_buf_len writable bytes.
pSrc_buf must point to at least src_buf_len readable bytes (or may be ignored if src_buf_len == 0).
flags may OR together TDEFL_* flags; the low 12 bits specify the max number of probes per dictionary search (0..4095, mask TDEFL_MAX_PROBES_MASK).
Caller must check for a 0 return value indicating failure (including insufficient out_buf_len).

functions.name: tdefl_write_image_to_png_file_in_memory_ex
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT void *tdefl_write_image_to_png_file_in_memory_ex(const void *pImage, int w, int h, int num_chans, size_t *pLen_out, mz_uint level, mz_bool flip);
functions.description: Encodes an interleaved 8-bit image (pitch = w*num_chans) to a PNG image stored in a newly allocated heap block. Returns a pointer to the PNG file data and sets *pLen_out to the PNG size. The image origin is top-left in memory; if flip is true the image is flipped vertically before encoding. The caller must mz_free() the returned block.
requirements: pImage must point to at least (size_t)w*h*num_chans bytes laid out row-major with pitch w*num_chans; the leftmost pixel of the top scanline is stored first.
w and h should be positive integers representing the image width and height.
num_chans must be 1, 2, 3, or 4.
pLen_out must be a valid, non-NULL pointer; set to the size of the PNG on success.
level may be in [0,10], or use constants like MZ_NO_COMPRESSION, MZ_BEST_SPEED, MZ_BEST_COMPRESSION, MZ_DEFAULT_LEVEL as documented.
flip may be any mz_bool; when true, the image is flipped on the Y axis prior to compression.
Returns NULL on failure; on success, the returned pointer must be freed with mz_free() (note: the allocated block may be larger than *pLen_out).

functions.name: tdefl_write_image_to_png_file_in_memory
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT void *tdefl_write_image_to_png_file_in_memory(const void *pImage, int w, int h, int num_chans, size_t *pLen_out);
functions.description: Convenience overload of PNG encoding with default compression parameters. Encodes an interleaved 8-bit image (pitch = w*num_chans) to a PNG in a newly allocated heap block and sets *pLen_out to the PNG size. The caller must mz_free() the returned block.
requirements: pImage must point to at least (size_t)w*h*num_chans bytes laid out row-major with pitch w*num_chans; the leftmost pixel of the top scanline is stored first.
w and h should be positive integers representing the image width and height.
num_chans must be 1, 2, 3, or 4.
pLen_out must be a valid, non-NULL pointer.
Returns NULL on failure; on success, the returned pointer must be freed with mz_free().

functions.name: tdefl_compress_mem_to_output
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_bool tdefl_compress_mem_to_output(const void *pBuf, size_t buf_len, tdefl_put_buf_func_ptr pPut_buf_func, void *pPut_buf_user, int flags);
functions.description: Compresses a contiguous memory buffer and streams the compressed data to a user-supplied callback. Suitable for streaming to custom sinks (files, sockets, etc.). Returns MZ_TRUE on success, MZ_FALSE on failure (e.g., callback signals failure).
requirements: pBuf must point to at least buf_len readable bytes (or may be unused if buf_len == 0).

pPut_buf_func must be a valid callback of type mz_bool (*)(const void*, int, void*); it will be invoked, typically with chunks up to TDEFL_OUT_BUF_SIZE bytes. It must return non-zero (true) to indicate success; returning zero signals failure.
pPut_buf_user is an opaque user pointer passed through to pPut_buf_func and may be NULL.
flags may OR together TDEFL_* flags; the low 12 bits specify the max number of probes per dictionary search (0..4095, mask TDEFL_MAX_PROBES_MASK).
Caller must check the mz_bool return value for success/failure.

functions.name: tdefl_init
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT tdefl_status tdefl_init(tdefl_compressor *d, tdefl_put_buf_func_ptr pPut_buf_func, void *pPut_buf_user, int flags);
functions.description: Initializes a tdefl_compressor state object for subsequent compression. No heap allocations are performed by this API. Depending on how the output is consumed, you will later use either tdefl_compress() (buffer-to-buffer) or tdefl_compress_buffer() (callback-driven) to feed/receive data. Note: the header’s comments about when pPut_buf_func should be NULL versus non-NULL are contradictory; consult the implementation or existing usage. The intent is to select either a callback-driven or buffer-driven mode at init time.
requirements: d must be a valid, non-NULL pointer to writable tdefl_compressor storage (properly sized as defined in this header).
pPut_buf_func and pPut_buf_user select callback-driven output when used; documentation contains ambiguity about NULL vs non-NULL usage—behavior details are unknown from this header alone.

flags may OR together TDEFL_* flags (e.g., TDEFL_WRITE_ZLIB_HEADER, TDEFL_COMPUTE_ADLER32, parsing flags); the low 12 bits specify the max number of probes per dictionary search (0..4095, mask TDEFL_MAX_PROBES_MASK).
Returns a tdefl_status indicating initialization result; callers must check for TDEFL_STATUS_OKAY before proceeding.

functions.name: tdefl_compress
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT tdefl_status tdefl_compress(tdefl_compressor *d, const void *pIn_buf, size_t *pIn_buf_size, void *pOut_buf, size_t *pOut_buf_size, tdefl_flush flush);
functions.description: Core low-level compression routine. Consumes up to *pIn_buf_size bytes from pIn_buf and produces up to *pOut_buf_size bytes of compressed data into pOut_buf, updating both size pointers with the actually consumed/produced byte counts. Use repeatedly until it returns TDEFL_STATUS_DONE when finishing with TDEFL_FINISH.
requirements: d must point to an initialized tdefl_compressor (via tdefl_init).
pIn_buf must point to at least *pIn_buf_size readable bytes if *pIn_buf_size > 0 (pIn_buf may be NULL if no input is provided).
pOut_buf must point to at least *pOut_buf_size writable bytes if *pOut_buf_size > 0 (pOut_buf may be NULL if no output buffer is provided).
pIn_buf_size and pOut_buf_size must be valid, non-NULL pointers and are updated on return to reflect bytes actually consumed/produced.
flush must be one of TDEFL_NO_FLUSH, TDEFL_SYNC_FLUSH, TDEFL_FULL_FLUSH, or TDEFL_FINISH.
Callers must handle return statuses: TDEFL_STATUS_OKAY (more work to do), TDEFL_STATUS_DONE (finished), TDEFL_STATUS_BAD_PARAM (invalid args), TDEFL_STATUS_PUT_BUF_FAILED (sink error).

functions.name: tdefl_compress_buffer
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT tdefl_status tdefl_compress_buffer(tdefl_compressor *d, const void *pIn_buf, size_t in_buf_size, tdefl_flush flush);
functions.description: Feeds a full input buffer into a compressor configured for callback-driven output (i.e., using the output callback set at init). This variant always consumes the entire input buffer in one call.
requirements: d must point to an initialized tdefl_compressor set up for callback-driven output (tdefl_init called with a non-NULL tdefl_put_buf_func_ptr, per the comment).
pIn_buf must point to at least in_buf_size readable bytes (or may be ignored if in_buf_size == 0).
flush must be one of TDEFL_NO_FLUSH, TDEFL_SYNC_FLUSH, TDEFL_FULL_FLUSH, or TDEFL_FINISH.
Always consumes the entire input buffer; caller should not expect partial consumption semantics.

functions.name: tdefl_get_prev_return_status
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT tdefl_status tdefl_get_prev_return_status(tdefl_compressor *d);
functions.description: Returns the previous tdefl_status produced by the compressor. Useful for inspecting the last outcome after a call into the compressor APIs.
requirements: d must be a valid, initialized tdefl_compressor pointer.

functions.name: tdefl_get_adler32
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_uint32 tdefl_get_adler32(tdefl_compressor *d);
functions.description: Returns the running Adler-32 checksum of the source data processed by the compressor. This value is produced when computing Adler-32 (e.g., when writing zlib headers or when TDEFL_COMPUTE_ADLER32 is set).
requirements: d must be a valid, initialized tdefl_compressor pointer.
Meaningfulness of the returned checksum depends on flags (e.g., TDEFL_WRITE_ZLIB_HEADER or TDEFL_COMPUTE_ADLER32); otherwise it may be unspecified.

functions.name: tdefl_create_comp_flags_from_zip_params
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_uint tdefl_create_comp_flags_from_zip_params(int level, int window_bits, int strategy);
functions.description: Builds a tdefl_init-compatible flags bitmask from zlib-style parameters. Use this to map (level, window_bits, strategy) to the TDEFL_* flags and probe count.
requirements: level may range from 0 to 10 (10 = maximum compression; may be substantially slower).
window_bits may be -15 (raw deflate) or 15 (zlib).
strategy must be one of MZ_DEFAULT_STRATEGY, MZ_FILTERED, MZ_HUFFMAN_ONLY, MZ_RLE, or MZ_FIXED.

functions.name: tdefl_compressor_alloc
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT tdefl_compressor *tdefl_compressor_alloc(void);
functions.description: Allocates a tdefl_compressor structure using the library’s allocation mechanism so bindings in other languages don’t need to know its size. Only available when MINIZ_NO_MALLOC is not defined.
requirements: Only available when MINIZ_NO_MALLOC is not defined at compile time.
Returns NULL on allocation failure; callers must check for NULL before use.
The returned compressor must be initialized with tdefl_init before compression.
Must be released with tdefl_compressor_free().

functions.name: tdefl_compressor_free
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT void tdefl_compressor_free(tdefl_compressor *pComp);
functions.description: Frees a tdefl_compressor previously allocated by tdefl_compressor_alloc(). Only available when MINIZ_NO_MALLOC is not defined.
requirements: Only available when MINIZ_NO_MALLOC is not defined at compile time.
pComp must be a pointer returned by tdefl_compressor_alloc() (or NULL is acceptable if the implementation allows; not stated here, so behavior on NULL is unknown).
After freeing, the pointer must not be used again.

functions.name: tinfl_decompress_mem_to_heap
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT void *tinfl_decompress_mem_to_heap(const void *pSrc_buf, size_t src_buf_len, size_t *pOut_len, int flags);
functions.description: Decompresses a Deflate or zlib-compressed memory block into a newly allocated heap buffer (malloc). On success returns a pointer to the decompressed data and sets *pOut_len to the decompressed size; on failure returns NULL. Intended for one-shot in-memory decompression; the caller must free the returned buffer with mz_free(). Flags control stream type (raw deflate vs. zlib header) and optional checksum computation.
requirements: pSrc_buf must point to the compressed input data when src_buf_len > 0.
pOut_len must be a valid, writable pointer; it will be set to the decompressed byte count on success.
flags may include TINFL_FLAG_PARSE_ZLIB_HEADER to indicate the input has a zlib header and ends with an adler32 checksum; otherwise the input is treated as a raw deflate stream.
flags may include TINFL_FLAG_COMPUTE_ADLER32 to force adler-32 computation; other flags are accepted but mainly relevant to the low-level API.
On success, the returned pointer must be freed by the caller using mz_free().
The function may return NULL on failure; callers must check for NULL before using the returned pointer.

functions.name: tinfl_decompress_mem_to_mem
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT size_t tinfl_decompress_mem_to_mem(void *pOut_buf, size_t out_buf_len, const void *pSrc_buf, size_t src_buf_len, int flags);
functions.description: Decompresses a Deflate or zlib-compressed memory block into a caller-supplied output buffer. Returns the number of bytes written on success, or TINFL_DECOMPRESS_MEM_TO_MEM_FAILED ((size_t)-1) on failure. Intended for one-shot in-memory decompression when the maximum output size is known.
requirements: pOut_buf must be a valid writable buffer of size out_buf_len bytes and large enough to hold the entire decompressed stream; otherwise the function fails with TINFL_DECOMPRESS_MEM_TO_MEM_FAILED.
pSrc_buf must point to the compressed input data when src_buf_len > 0.
flags may include TINFL_FLAG_PARSE_ZLIB_HEADER to indicate the input has a zlib header and adler32; otherwise the input is treated as a raw deflate stream.
flags may include TINFL_FLAG_COMPUTE_ADLER32 to force adler-32 computation.
Callers must check the return value and treat ((size_t)-1) as failure.
If the output buffer is known to be large enough to hold the entire stream, setting TINFL_FLAG_USING_NON_WRAPPING_OUTPUT_BUF is appropriate (per API flag semantics).

functions.name: tinfl_decompress_mem_to_callback
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT int tinfl_decompress_mem_to_callback(const void *pIn_buf, size_t *pIn_buf_size, tinfl_put_buf_func_ptr pPut_buf_func, void *pPut_buf_user, int flags);
functions.description: Decompresses a Deflate or zlib-compressed memory block and streams the decompressed data through an internal ~32KB buffer to a user-provided callback. Returns 1 on success, 0 on failure. Useful for streaming output without preallocating a large output buffer.
requirements: pIn_buf must point to the compressed input data when *pIn_buf_size > 0.
pIn_buf_size must be a valid, writable pointer; on entry it specifies the input size. It may be updated by the function to reflect bytes consumed (exact postconditions are not explicitly documented).

pPut_buf_func must be a valid function pointer with signature int (*)(const void *pBuf, int len, void *pUser); it will be called with chunks of decompressed data. It should return non-zero on success and zero to indicate failure.
pPut_buf_user is an opaque user pointer passed through to pPut_buf_func.
flags may include TINFL_FLAG_PARSE_ZLIB_HEADER for zlib-wrapped input and TINFL_FLAG_COMPUTE_ADLER32 to compute adler-32.
Callers must check the return value (1 indicates success; 0 indicates failure).
The callback may be invoked multiple times with up to approximately 32KB chunks; it must tolerate arbitrary chunking.

functions.name: tinfl_decompressor_alloc
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT tinfl_decompressor *tinfl_decompressor_alloc(void);
functions.description: Allocates a tinfl_decompressor object via the library’s allocation mechanism, so non-C bindings need not manage structure size or allocation. Available only when compiled without MINIZ_NO_MALLOC defined. Use tinfl_decompressor_free() to release.
requirements: Only available if MINIZ_NO_MALLOC is not defined at compile time; otherwise this symbol may be unavailable.
On success returns a non-NULL pointer to a tinfl_decompressor that must be freed with tinfl_decompressor_free().
Callers must check for NULL return to detect allocation failure before using the object.

functions.name: tinfl_decompressor_free
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT void tinfl_decompressor_free(tinfl_decompressor *pDecomp);
functions.description: Frees a tinfl_decompressor object previously allocated by tinfl_decompressor_alloc(). Available only when compiled without MINIZ_NO_MALLOC defined.
requirements: pDecomp must be a pointer previously returned by tinfl_decompressor_alloc() and not already freed.
Only available if MINIZ_NO_MALLOC is not defined at compile time; otherwise this symbol may be unavailable.

functions.name: tinfl_decompress
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT tinfl_status tinfl_decompress(tinfl_decompressor *r, const mz_uint8 *pIn_buf_next, size_t *pIn_buf_size, mz_uint8 *pOut_buf_start, mz_uint8 *pOut_buf_next, size_t *pOut_buf_size, const mz_uint32 decomp_flags);
functions.description: Core low-level decompression coroutine for Deflate/zlib streams. Drives the inflator incrementally: consumes up to *pIn_buf_size bytes from pIn_buf_next and produces up to *pOut_buf_size bytes to the output buffer starting at pOut_buf_start (current write position pOut_buf_next). Updates the size pointers to reflect bytes consumed/produced and returns a tinfl_status indicating progress or completion. Supports both raw deflate and zlib-wrapped data, optional adler-32 computation, and either non-wrapping full-output buffers or dictionary-sized circular buffers.
requirements: r must point to a valid tinfl_decompressor instance initialized with tinfl_init(r) before first use, and re-initialized via tinfl_init(r) after fatal failures if reuse is desired.
pIn_buf_size must be a valid, writable pointer specifying the number of available input bytes on entry; it will be updated to the number of bytes actually consumed.

pIn_buf_next must point to the first available input byte when *pIn_buf_size > 0. If there is more input available beyond pIn_buf_next + *pIn_buf_size, set TINFL_FLAG_HAS_MORE_INPUT in decomp_flags; otherwise clear it.
pOut_buf_start must point to the beginning of the output buffer; pOut_buf_next must point to the current output position within the same buffer.
pOut_buf_size must be a valid, writable pointer specifying the number of writable bytes available at pOut_buf_next on entry; it will be updated to the number of bytes actually written.

If using a non-wrapping output buffer that can hold the entire decompressed stream, set TINFL_FLAG_USING_NON_WRAPPING_OUTPUT_BUF in decomp_flags. Otherwise, the output buffer capacity must be at least TINFL_LZ_DICT_SIZE (32768) bytes to support dictionary-based wrapping.
Set TINFL_FLAG_PARSE_ZLIB_HEADER in decomp_flags when the input has a zlib header and adler32 checksum; otherwise the input is treated as a raw deflate stream.
Set TINFL_FLAG_COMPUTE_ADLER32 in decomp_flags to force adler-32 checksum computation of decompressed bytes; the current adler32 can be queried via tinfl_get_adler32(r).

Caller must handle return statuses: TINFL_STATUS_DONE indicates successful end of stream; TINFL_STATUS_NEEDS_MORE_INPUT indicates more input is required (or clear HAS_MORE_INPUT if none remains); TINFL_STATUS_HAS_MORE_OUTPUT indicates the output buffer is full and the caller must provide more space; any status < TINFL_STATUS_DONE indicates failure.
After a failure status (TINFL_STATUS_FAILED, TINFL_STATUS_BAD_PARAM, or TINFL_STATUS_FAILED_CANNOT_MAKE_PROGRESS), calling again without tinfl_init(r) will continue to return the same failure status.
In streaming use, the caller should loop, adjusting input/output pointers and sizes according to the updated *pIn_buf_size and *pOut_buf_size, until TINFL_STATUS_DONE or an error is returned.

functions.name: mz_zip_reader_init
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_bool mz_zip_reader_init(mz_zip_archive *pZip, mz_uint64 size, mz_uint flags);
functions.description: Initializes a ZIP archive reader over a custom I/O source already attached to pZip (callbacks in pZip). Reads and validates the archive's central directory of the given size with the provided flags.
requirements: pZip must be a valid pointer to an mz_zip_archive structure.
pZip must have been zeroed or otherwise properly initialized before calling (see mz_zip_zero_struct).
pZip must have its read callbacks set appropriately for the data source if using user I/O.
size specifies the archive size and must be correct for proper validation.
flags may include validation options such as MZ_ZIP_FLAG_VALIDATE_HEADERS_ONLY.

functions.name: mz_zip_reader_init_mem
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_bool mz_zip_reader_init_mem(mz_zip_archive *pZip, const void *pMem, size_t size, mz_uint flags);
functions.description: Initializes a ZIP reader over a memory buffer. Reads and validates the central directory within the provided memory region.
requirements: pZip must be zeroed/cleared prior to use (see mz_zip_zero_struct).
pMem must point to a readable buffer of at least size bytes.
size must be the exact size of the archive in memory.
flags controls behavior/validation; only documented flags should be used.

functions.name: mz_zip_reader_init_file
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_bool mz_zip_reader_init_file(mz_zip_archive *pZip, const char *pFilename, mz_uint32 flags);
functions.description: Opens a ZIP archive from a disk file by filename and initializes the reader, reading and validating the central directory.
requirements: Available only when MINIZ_NO_STDIO is not defined.
pZip must be zeroed before use (mz_zip_zero_struct).
pFilename must be a valid, null-terminated path to a readable file.
flags is a 32-bit flag set controlling read/validation behavior.

functions.name: mz_zip_reader_init_file_v2
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_bool mz_zip_reader_init_file_v2(mz_zip_archive *pZip, const char *pFilename, mz_uint flags, mz_uint64 file_start_ofs, mz_uint64 archive_size);
functions.description: Variant of mz_zip_reader_init_file allowing a non-zero start offset and explicit archive size within the file. Initializes reader and validates central directory.
requirements: Available only when MINIZ_NO_STDIO is not defined.
pZip must be zeroed before use (mz_zip_zero_struct).
pFilename must reference a readable file.
file_start_ofs is the byte offset where the archive begins within the file (0 for start).
archive_size is the true size of the archive region; if 0, the entire remainder of the file is treated as the archive.
flags controls behavior/validation.

functions.name: mz_zip_reader_init_cfile
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_bool mz_zip_reader_init_cfile(mz_zip_archive *pZip, MZ_FILE *pFile, mz_uint64 archive_size, mz_uint flags);
functions.description: Initializes a ZIP reader from an already-opened FILE stream at its current position. Does not close the FILE on end.
requirements: Available only when MINIZ_NO_STDIO is not defined.
pZip must be zeroed before use (mz_zip_zero_struct).
pFile must be a valid, open MZ_FILE* positioned at the start of the archive data.
archive_size is the number of bytes containing the archive; if 0, the archive is assumed to consume the rest of the stream.
Caller retains responsibility for closing pFile; mz_zip_reader_end will not close it.

functions.name: mz_zip_reader_end
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_bool mz_zip_reader_end(mz_zip_archive *pZip);
functions.description: Ends reading on a ZIP archive, freeing allocations and closing any input file if it was opened by mz_zip_reader_init_file/v2.
requirements: pZip must have been successfully initialized for reading.
If initialized with mz_zip_reader_init_cfile, the FILE will NOT be closed; caller must close it.
After calling, pZip is no longer valid for reading operations.

functions.name: mz_zip_zero_struct
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT void mz_zip_zero_struct(mz_zip_archive *pZip);
functions.description: Clears an mz_zip_archive structure to all zeros. Must be called before passing the struct to any mz_zip functions.
requirements: pZip must be a valid pointer.
Must be called before any mz_zip init function to ensure defined initial state.

functions.name: mz_zip_get_mode
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_zip_mode mz_zip_get_mode(mz_zip_archive *pZip);
functions.description: Returns the current operational mode of the archive (invalid, reading, writing, or finalized).
requirements: pZip must point to an mz_zip_archive previously zeroed/initialized.

functions.name: mz_zip_get_type
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_zip_type mz_zip_get_type(mz_zip_archive *pZip);
functions.description: Returns the I/O backing type for the archive (user, memory, heap, file, cfile).
requirements: pZip must point to an mz_zip_archive previously zeroed/initialized.

functions.name: mz_zip_reader_get_num_files
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_uint mz_zip_reader_get_num_files(mz_zip_archive *pZip);
functions.description: Returns the total number of file entries in the archive.
requirements: pZip must be initialized in reading mode.

functions.name: mz_zip_get_archive_size
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_uint64 mz_zip_get_archive_size(mz_zip_archive *pZip);
functions.description: Returns the total size of the archive in bytes.
requirements: pZip must be initialized.

functions.name: mz_zip_get_archive_file_start_offset
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_uint64 mz_zip_get_archive_file_start_offset(mz_zip_archive *pZip);
functions.description: Returns the starting file offset, in bytes, where the archive begins in its underlying file/stream.
requirements: pZip must be initialized.

functions.name: mz_zip_get_cfile
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT MZ_FILE *mz_zip_get_cfile(mz_zip_archive *pZip);
functions.description: Returns the underlying FILE pointer when the archive is backed by a FILE (cfile mode), otherwise may be NULL.
requirements: Available only when MINIZ_NO_STDIO is not defined.
pZip must be initialized.

functions.name: mz_zip_read_archive_data
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT size_t mz_zip_read_archive_data(mz_zip_archive *pZip, mz_uint64 file_ofs, void *pBuf, size_t n);
functions.description: Reads n bytes of raw archive data starting at absolute file offset file_ofs into pBuf using the archive’s I/O callbacks.
requirements: pZip must be initialized with readable backing store.
pBuf must point to at least n writable bytes.
file_ofs+n must be within the accessible archive backing store region.

functions.name: mz_zip_set_last_error
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_zip_error mz_zip_set_last_error(mz_zip_archive *pZip, mz_zip_error err_num);
functions.description: Sets pZip->m_last_error to err_num and returns the value. Not thread-safe.
requirements: pZip must be a valid pointer to an mz_zip_archive.
err_num must be a valid mz_zip_error enum value.
Callers must not rely on thread-safety for m_last_error updates.

functions.name: mz_zip_peek_last_error
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_zip_error mz_zip_peek_last_error(mz_zip_archive *pZip);
functions.description: Returns the current last error recorded in pZip without clearing it. Not thread-safe.
requirements: pZip must be valid.
Callers must account for non-thread-safe access to m_last_error.

functions.name: mz_zip_clear_last_error
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_zip_error mz_zip_clear_last_error(mz_zip_archive *pZip);
functions.description: Clears pZip->m_last_error and returns the previous error. Not thread-safe.
requirements: pZip must be valid.
Not thread-safe; synchronize externally if accessed concurrently.

functions.name: mz_zip_get_last_error
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_zip_error mz_zip_get_last_error(mz_zip_archive *pZip);
functions.description: Returns and may update the last error associated with pZip (same stored field). Not thread-safe.
requirements: pZip must be valid.
Not thread-safe; external synchronization required in multithreaded use.

functions.name: mz_zip_get_error_string
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT const char *mz_zip_get_error_string(mz_zip_error mz_err);
functions.description: Returns a static human-readable string describing the given mz_zip_error code.
requirements: mz_err must be a valid mz_zip_error value.

functions.name: mz_zip_reader_is_file_a_directory
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_bool mz_zip_reader_is_file_a_directory(mz_zip_archive *pZip, mz_uint file_index);
functions.description: Returns MZ_TRUE if the specified archive entry is a directory.
requirements: pZip must be initialized in reading mode.
file_index must be a valid index [0, mz_zip_reader_get_num_files(pZip)).

functions.name: mz_zip_reader_is_file_encrypted
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_bool mz_zip_reader_is_file_encrypted(mz_zip_archive *pZip, mz_uint file_index);
functions.description: Returns MZ_TRUE if the archive entry is marked as encrypted/strong encrypted (unsupported by miniz for extraction).
requirements: pZip must be initialized in reading mode.
file_index must be within range of entries.

functions.name: mz_zip_reader_is_file_supported
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_bool mz_zip_reader_is_file_supported(mz_zip_archive *pZip, mz_uint file_index);
functions.description: Returns MZ_TRUE if the file is not encrypted, not a compressed patch, and uses a supported compression method.
requirements: pZip must be initialized in reading mode.
file_index must be valid.

functions.name: mz_zip_reader_get_filename
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_uint mz_zip_reader_get_filename(mz_zip_archive *pZip, mz_uint file_index, char *pFilename, mz_uint filename_buf_size);
functions.description: Retrieves the filename of an archive entry. Returns bytes written, or if filename_buf_size==0, returns the required size.
requirements: pZip must be initialized for reading.
file_index must be valid.
If pFilename is non-NULL, it must point to a buffer of at least filename_buf_size bytes.
The returned string is zero-terminated and may be truncated to fit.

functions.name: mz_zip_reader_locate_file
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT int mz_zip_reader_locate_file(mz_zip_archive *pZip, const char *pName, const char *pComment, mz_uint flags);
functions.description: Searches the central directory for a file by name (and optional comment) with flags controlling case/path handling. Returns the file index, or -1 if not found.
requirements: pZip must be initialized for reading.
pName must be a valid null-terminated file name to search.
pComment may be NULL to ignore comment matching.
flags may include MZ_ZIP_FLAG_CASE_SENSITIVE and/or MZ_ZIP_FLAG_IGNORE_PATH.

functions.name: mz_zip_reader_locate_file_v2
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_bool mz_zip_reader_locate_file_v2(mz_zip_archive *pZip, const char *pName, const char *pComment, mz_uint flags, mz_uint32 *file_index);
functions.description: Searches for a file and writes its index to file_index if found, returning MZ_TRUE on success.
requirements: pZip must be initialized for reading.
pName must be a valid null-terminated file name.
pComment may be NULL.
file_index must be a non-NULL output pointer.
flags may include MZ_ZIP_FLAG_CASE_SENSITIVE and/or MZ_ZIP_FLAG_IGNORE_PATH.

functions.name: mz_zip_reader_file_stat
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_bool mz_zip_reader_file_stat(mz_zip_archive *pZip, mz_uint file_index, mz_zip_archive_file_stat *pStat);
functions.description: Retrieves detailed central directory information for the specified file entry and writes it to pStat.
requirements: pZip must be initialized for reading.
file_index must be valid.
pStat must be a non-NULL pointer to an mz_zip_archive_file_stat struct to receive data.

functions.name: mz_zip_is_zip64
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_bool mz_zip_is_zip64(mz_zip_archive *pZip);
functions.description: Returns MZ_TRUE if the archive uses ZIP64 format (zip64 end of central dir or zip64 extended info present).
requirements: pZip must be initialized.

functions.name: mz_zip_get_central_dir_size
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT size_t mz_zip_get_central_dir_size(mz_zip_archive *pZip);
functions.description: Returns the total central directory size in bytes (supported up to <= MZ_UINT32_MAX).
requirements: pZip must be initialized.
The returned size is limited to the max supported size.

functions.name: mz_zip_reader_extract_to_mem_no_alloc
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_bool mz_zip_reader_extract_to_mem_no_alloc(mz_zip_archive *pZip, mz_uint file_index, void *pBuf, size_t buf_size, mz_uint flags, void *pUser_read_buf, size_t user_read_buf_size);
functions.description: Extracts a file into a caller-provided memory buffer without dynamic allocation. Intended for stack-only state using a caller-provided read buffer.
requirements: pZip must be initialized for reading.
file_index must refer to a supported, non-encrypted file entry.
pBuf must point to a writable buffer of at least buf_size bytes (should be >= uncompressed size).
There must be at least enough room on the stack for the inflator’s state (~34KB) as noted by documentation.
pUser_read_buf must point to a buffer of at least user_read_buf_size bytes if non-NULL.
flags controls extraction behavior (e.g., CRC checking can be disabled only if compiled with MINIZ_DISABLE_ZIP_READER_CRC32_CHECKS).

functions.name: mz_zip_reader_extract_file_to_mem_no_alloc
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_bool mz_zip_reader_extract_file_to_mem_no_alloc(mz_zip_archive *pZip, const char *pFilename, void *pBuf, size_t buf_size, mz_uint flags, void *pUser_read_buf, size_t user_read_buf_size);
functions.description: Extracts a named file into a caller-provided buffer without allocation, using a provided read buffer for I/O.
requirements: pZip must be initialized for reading.
pFilename must name an existing entry; search respects locate flags via defaults.
pBuf must be large enough for output data.
pUser_read_buf and size must be valid if provided.
flags controls extraction behavior.

functions.name: mz_zip_reader_extract_to_mem
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_bool mz_zip_reader_extract_to_mem(mz_zip_archive *pZip, mz_uint file_index, void *pBuf, size_t buf_size, mz_uint flags);
functions.description: Extracts an archive file to a caller-provided memory buffer, allocating internal temp memory as needed.
requirements: pZip must be initialized for reading.
file_index must be valid and refer to a supported, non-encrypted entry.
pBuf must be a writable buffer of at least buf_size bytes (>= uncompressed size).
flags controls extraction behavior.

functions.name: mz_zip_reader_extract_file_to_mem
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_bool mz_zip_reader_extract_file_to_mem(mz_zip_archive *pZip, const char *pFilename, void *pBuf, size_t buf_size, mz_uint flags);
functions.description: Extracts an archive file specified by name to a caller-provided buffer.
requirements: pZip must be initialized for reading.
pFilename must name an entry in the archive.
pBuf must be large enough for the output.
flags controls extraction behavior.

functions.name: mz_zip_reader_extract_to_heap
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT void *mz_zip_reader_extract_to_heap(mz_zip_archive *pZip, mz_uint file_index, size_t *pSize, mz_uint flags);
functions.description: Extracts a file into a newly allocated heap buffer using the archive's alloc/realloc callbacks. Returns pointer on success, NULL on failure, and sets last error.
requirements: pZip must be initialized for reading.
file_index must be valid and supported.
pSize may be NULL or a valid pointer to receive the extracted size.
Caller must free the returned buffer using the matching free function (per pZip's allocator) when done.
flags controls extraction behavior.

functions.name: mz_zip_reader_extract_file_to_heap
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT void *mz_zip_reader_extract_file_to_heap(mz_zip_archive *pZip, const char *pFilename, size_t *pSize, mz_uint flags);
functions.description: Extracts a named file to a newly allocated heap buffer using the archive's allocator.
requirements: pZip must be initialized for reading.
pFilename must name an entry in the archive.
pSize may be NULL or valid to receive size.
Caller must free the buffer with the correct deallocator.
flags controls extraction behavior.

functions.name: mz_zip_reader_extract_to_callback
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_bool mz_zip_reader_extract_to_callback(mz_zip_archive *pZip, mz_uint file_index, mz_file_write_func pCallback, void *pOpaque, mz_uint flags);
functions.description: Extracts a file and streams the decompressed data to a user-supplied write callback.
requirements: pZip must be initialized for reading.
file_index must be valid and supported.
pCallback must be a valid function pointer accepting data chunks; it must handle sequential writes and return size written.
pOpaque is passed through to the callback and may be NULL.
flags controls extraction behavior.

functions.name: mz_zip_reader_extract_file_to_callback
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_bool mz_zip_reader_extract_file_to_callback(mz_zip_archive *pZip, const char *pFilename, mz_file_write_func pCallback, void *pOpaque, mz_uint flags);
functions.description: Extracts a named file and streams the output through a user-provided write callback.
requirements: pZip must be initialized for reading.
pFilename must match an entry name.
pCallback must be valid and able to consume data provided.
flags controls extraction behavior.

functions.name: mz_zip_reader_extract_iter_new
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_zip_reader_extract_iter_state *mz_zip_reader_extract_iter_new(mz_zip_archive *pZip, mz_uint file_index, mz_uint flags);
functions.description: Creates a new iterative extraction state for the specified file, enabling chunked reads via mz_zip_reader_extract_iter_read.
requirements: pZip must be initialized for reading.
file_index must be valid and supported for extraction.
Caller must later free the returned state with mz_zip_reader_extract_iter_free.
flags controls extraction behavior.

functions.name: mz_zip_reader_extract_file_iter_new
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_zip_reader_extract_file_iter_state *mz_zip_reader_extract_file_iter_new(mz_zip_archive *pZip, const char *pFilename, mz_uint flags);
functions.description: Creates an iterative extraction state for a file given by name, allowing incremental reads.
requirements: pZip must be initialized for reading.
pFilename must name an entry.
Caller must free the state with mz_zip_reader_extract_iter_free.
flags controls extraction behavior.

functions.name: mz_zip_reader_extract_iter_read
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT size_t mz_zip_reader_extract_iter_read(mz_zip_reader_extract_iter_state *pState, void *pvBuf, size_t buf_size);
functions.description: Reads the next chunk of decompressed data from an iterative extraction state into pvBuf, returning number of bytes produced.
requirements: pState must be a valid state returned by mz_zip_reader_extract_iter_new/_file_iter_new.
pvBuf must point to a writable buffer of at least buf_size bytes.
Caller should continue calling until 0 indicates end-of-file or an error condition has been reported via last error.

functions.name: mz_zip_reader_extract_iter_free
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_bool mz_zip_reader_extract_iter_free(mz_zip_reader_extract_iter_state *pState);
functions.description: Frees resources associated with an iterative extraction state.
requirements: pState must be a state created by the matching iter_new function.
After freeing, pState must not be used.

functions.name: mz_zip_reader_extract_to_file
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_bool mz_zip_reader_extract_to_file(mz_zip_archive *pZip, mz_uint file_index, const char *pDst_filename, mz_uint flags);
functions.description: Extracts a file entry to a destination disk file path, setting its last accessed and modified times. Skips directory entries.
requirements: Available only when MINIZ_NO_STDIO is not defined.
pZip must be initialized for reading.
file_index must refer to a file (not a directory).
pDst_filename must be a valid writable path.
flags controls extraction behavior.

functions.name: mz_zip_reader_extract_file_to_file
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_bool mz_zip_reader_extract_file_to_file(mz_zip_archive *pZip, const char *pArchive_filename, const char *pDst_filename, mz_uint flags);
functions.description: Extracts a named archive file to a destination disk file path, setting file times. Directory records are not extracted.
requirements: Available only when MINIZ_NO_STDIO is not defined.
pZip must be initialized for reading.
pArchive_filename must match an archive file entry (not a directory).
pDst_filename must be a valid path for writing.
flags controls extraction behavior.

functions.name: mz_zip_reader_extract_to_cfile
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_bool mz_zip_reader_extract_to_cfile(mz_zip_archive *pZip, mz_uint file_index, MZ_FILE *File, mz_uint flags);
functions.description: Extracts an entry and writes the output to the current position in a provided FILE stream.
requirements: Available only when MINIZ_NO_STDIO is not defined.
pZip must be initialized for reading.
file_index must be valid and supported.
File must be a valid, writable MZ_FILE* positioned where data should be written.
flags controls extraction behavior.

functions.name: mz_zip_reader_extract_file_to_cfile
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_bool mz_zip_reader_extract_file_to_cfile(mz_zip_archive *pZip, const char *pArchive_filename, MZ_FILE *pFile, mz_uint flags);
functions.description: Extracts a named entry to a provided FILE stream at its current position.
requirements: Available only when MINIZ_NO_STDIO is not defined.
pZip must be initialized for reading.
pArchive_filename must match an entry.
pFile must be a valid, writable MZ_FILE*.
flags controls extraction behavior.

functions.name: mz_zip_validate_file
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_bool mz_zip_validate_file(mz_zip_archive *pZip, mz_uint file_index, mz_uint flags);
functions.description: Validates the specified file by comparing its local headers (and optional zip64/info/descriptor) with central directory data and, unless headers-only flag is set, fully decompresses to verify CRC.
requirements: pZip must be initialized for reading.
file_index must be valid.
flags may include MZ_ZIP_FLAG_VALIDATE_HEADERS_ONLY to skip full decompression.
May call locate-file validation if MZ_ZIP_FLAG_VALIDATE_LOCATE_FILE_FLAG is enabled.

functions.name: mz_zip_validate_archive
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_bool mz_zip_validate_archive(mz_zip_archive *pZip, mz_uint flags);
functions.description: Validates the entire archive by invoking mz_zip_validate_file() on each entry.
requirements: pZip must be initialized for reading.
flags are passed to per-file validation.

functions.name: mz_zip_validate_mem_archive
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_bool mz_zip_validate_mem_archive(const void *pMem, size_t size, mz_uint flags, mz_zip_error *pErr);
functions.description: Validates an in-memory archive blob. On failure, sets *pErr to an mz_zip_error value.
requirements: pMem must point to a readable memory buffer of at least size bytes.
size must be the archive size.
pErr may be NULL; if non-NULL, it receives the error code on failure.
flags control validation (e.g., headers-only).

functions.name: mz_zip_validate_file_archive
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_bool mz_zip_validate_file_archive(const char *pFilename, mz_uint flags, mz_zip_error *pErr);
functions.description: Validates a disk file archive by filename. On failure, writes an error code to pErr.
requirements: Available only when MINIZ_NO_STDIO is not defined.
pFilename must be a readable path to an archive.
pErr may be NULL; if non-NULL, receives error code on failure.
flags control validation behavior.

functions.name: mz_zip_end
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_bool mz_zip_end(mz_zip_archive *pZip);
functions.description: Universal end function: calls mz_zip_reader_end() or mz_zip_writer_end() depending on current mode.
requirements: pZip must be initialized in either reading or writing mode.
Writer archives must have been finalized before ending; this function will not finalize automatically.

functions.name: mz_zip_writer_init
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_bool mz_zip_writer_init(mz_zip_archive *pZip, mz_uint64 existing_size);
functions.description: Initializes a ZIP writer over a user-provided write callback/opaque already set in pZip. Output is streamable (file offsets only increase).
requirements: pZip must be zeroed before use (mz_zip_zero_struct).
Set pZip->m_pWrite (and m_pIO_opaque) before calling.
existing_size specifies pre-existing output size (for appending within a stream).

functions.name: mz_zip_writer_init_v2
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_bool mz_zip_writer_init_v2(mz_zip_archive *pZip, mz_uint64 existing_size, mz_uint flags);
functions.description: Like mz_zip_writer_init, but allows writer flags (e.g., MZ_ZIP_FLAG_WRITE_ZIP64, MZ_ZIP_FLAG_WRITE_ALLOW_READING).
requirements: pZip must be zeroed first.
pZip->m_pWrite and possibly m_pIO_opaque must be set before calling.
existing_size is the current size of the destination stream.
flags controls writer behavior (e.g., zip64 forcing).

functions.name: mz_zip_writer_init_heap
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_bool mz_zip_writer_init_heap(mz_zip_archive *pZip, size_t size_to_reserve_at_beginning, size_t initial_allocation_size);
functions.description: Initializes a ZIP writer that outputs to a growable heap buffer managed by the archive's allocator.
requirements: pZip must be zeroed first.
size_to_reserve_at_beginning reserves leading bytes in the output buffer.
initial_allocation_size specifies initial heap allocation for output.

functions.name: mz_zip_writer_init_heap_v2
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_bool mz_zip_writer_init_heap_v2(mz_zip_archive *pZip, size_t size_to_reserve_at_beginning, size_t initial_allocation_size, mz_uint flags);
functions.description: Heap writer initialization with additional writer flags.
requirements: pZip must be zeroed first.
size_to_reserve_at_beginning and initial_allocation_size must be reasonable sizes.
flags controls writer behavior (e.g., MZ_ZIP_FLAG_WRITE_ZIP64).

functions.name: mz_zip_writer_init_file
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_bool mz_zip_writer_init_file(mz_zip_archive *pZip, const char *pFilename, mz_uint64 size_to_reserve_at_beginning);
functions.description: Initializes a writer that outputs directly to a disk file path, reserving an optional prefix region.
requirements: Available only when MINIZ_NO_STDIO is not defined.
pZip must be zeroed first.
pFilename must be a valid path for creating/writing.
size_to_reserve_at_beginning reserves leading bytes before ZIP data.

functions.name: mz_zip_writer_init_file_v2
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_bool mz_zip_writer_init_file_v2(mz_zip_archive *pZip, const char *pFilename, mz_uint64 size_to_reserve_at_beginning, mz_uint flags);
functions.description: File writer initialization with additional writer flags.
requirements: Available only when MINIZ_NO_STDIO is not defined.
pZip must be zeroed first.
pFilename must be a valid writable path.
flags controls writer behavior (e.g., force ZIP64).
size_to_reserve_at_beginning reserves leading bytes.

functions.name: mz_zip_writer_init_cfile
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_bool mz_zip_writer_init_cfile(mz_zip_archive *pZip, MZ_FILE *pFile, mz_uint flags);
functions.description: Initializes a writer that outputs to an already opened FILE stream.
requirements: Available only when MINIZ_NO_STDIO is not defined.
pZip must be zeroed first.
pFile must be a valid, writable MZ_FILE*.
flags controls writer behavior.

functions.name: mz_zip_writer_init_from_reader
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_bool mz_zip_writer_init_from_reader(mz_zip_archive *pZip, const char *pFilename);
functions.description: Converts a reader into a writer to allow in-place append to an existing archive. May reopen the file by filename if needed; otherwise, falls back to reader_end on failure.
requirements: If the archive was opened with mz_zip_reader_init_file, pFilename must be the same archive filename so it can be reopened for writing.
For mem-backed archives (mz_zip_reader_init_mem), the memory must be growable via the realloc callback.
For custom I/O (mz_zip_reader_init), m_pWrite must not be NULL.
In-place modification is risky; if the process is interrupted before finalize, the central directory may be corrupted.

functions.name: mz_zip_writer_init_from_reader_v2
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_bool mz_zip_writer_init_from_reader_v2(mz_zip_archive *pZip, const char *pFilename, mz_uint flags);
functions.description: Like mz_zip_writer_init_from_reader but accepts writer flags.
requirements: Same requirements as mz_zip_writer_init_from_reader regarding source type and pFilename when file-backed.
flags controls writer behavior (e.g., write zip64, allow reading).

functions.name: mz_zip_writer_add_mem
functions.signature: MINIZ_EXPORT mz_bool mz_zip_writer_add_mem(mz_zip_archive *pZip, const char *pArchive_name, const void *pBuf, size_t buf_size, mz_uint level_and_flags);
functions.description: Adds a file entry from a memory buffer, recording the current local time. Use an archive name ending with '/' and empty buffer to add a directory.
requirements: pZip must be initialized for writing.
pArchive_name must be a valid, null-terminated path within the zip (use '/' separators; trailing '/' indicates directory).
pBuf must point to at least buf_size bytes (may be 0 for directory).
level_and_flags: compression level (0-10 or MZ_DEFAULT_COMPRESSION) OR’d with mz_zip_flags as needed.

functions.name: mz_zip_writer_add_mem_ex
